en_title: Oded Fehr Gives First Look at Ardeth Bay in The Mummy 4
subtitle: 老角色归来
opus_summary: Oded Fehr确认回归《The Mummy 4》饰演Ardeth Bay，并晒出妆造首瞥。影片剧情仍保密，但可能与Imhotep回归有关，定于2027年10月15日上映。

paragraphs.en: Ardeth Bay is returning in The Mummy 4, as is his original actor Oded Fehr, who gave fans a sneak peek at what the character looks like after all these years.
paragraphs.cn: Ardeth Bay将回归《The Mummy 4》，其原演员Oded Fehr也会回归，并让影迷抢先看到这个角色多年后的模样。

paragraphs.en: Brendan Fraser and co. are making their long-awaited return in the fourth installment of The Mummy franchise, the first in nearly 20 years. Fraser’s Rick O'Connell and Rachel Weisz’s Evelyn Carnahan were already confirmed to bring the series’ jaunty, humorous action back to the silver screen, as was John Hannah as Carnahan’s brother.
paragraphs.cn: Brendan Fraser等人将回归期待已久的《The Mummy》系列第四部，这也是该系列近20年来的首部新作。此前已确认，Fraser饰演的Rick O'Connell和Rachel Weisz饰演的Evelyn Carnahan将把该系列轻快幽默的动作风格带回大银幕，Carnahan的兄弟则由John Hannah饰演。

paragraphs.en: The last of these casting announcements surfaced in March 2026; as of August, another big player is confirmed to re-join the crew, and he’s one with whom longtime fans will certainly be familiar.
paragraphs.cn: 这些选角消息中，最近一则于2026年3月公布；截至8月，又一位重要演员确认回归，而且长期影迷肯定对他很熟悉。

paragraphs.en: Oded Fehr is making his grand return to The Mummy 4 as Ardeth Bay, who previously appeared in the original Mummy film as well as The Mummy Returns in 2001. He was notably absent from 2008’s The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor, saying that without Imhotep as the big baddie, his character wouldn’t have any reason to appear.
paragraphs.cn: Oded Fehr将以Ardeth Bay一角盛大回归《The Mummy 4》。该角色曾出现在最初的《The Mummy》电影以及2001年的《The Mummy Returns》中。2008年的《The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor》明显没有他；Fehr当时表示，既然没有Imhotep这个大反派，他的角色就没有出现的理由。

paragraphs.en: It seems that Imhotep may have risen again, as Fehr has confirmed that he is involved in the new movie and even showed off a glimpse at what Ardeth Bay looks like eighteen years after the last film.
paragraphs.cn: Imhotep似乎可能再次复活，因为Fehr已确认参与新片，甚至展示了Ardeth Bay在上一部电影18年后的模样。

paragraphs.en: He shared the update in a post on his personal Instagram account on August 4, showing a clip of Ardeth in the original movie that then transitions to an image of fifty-five-year-old Fehr sitting in a makeup chair. Sporting a short haircut, a neat beard, and his signature facial tattoos, the now-silver Ardeth Bay looks as dashing as ever, and fans didn’t hesitate to express their excitement at his return.
paragraphs.cn: 8月4日，他在个人Instagram账号发帖分享了这一消息：帖子先展示原电影中的Ardeth片段，随后转为55岁的Fehr坐在化妆椅上的画面。如今银发的Ardeth Bay留着短发、修剪整齐的胡子和标志性面部纹身，依然风度翩翩，影迷也毫不犹豫地表达了对他回归的兴奋。

paragraphs.en: Given his staunch dedication to Bay’s character and his refusal to return to the franchise if things didn’t make sense for him, it could be possible that Imhotep is also playing a significant role in the events of The Mummy 4. For now, its plot is still under wraps, but it has already received a release date for October 15, 2027.
paragraphs.cn: 考虑到他对Bay这个角色的坚定投入，以及若剧情无法自洽便拒绝回归该系列的态度，Imhotep也有可能在《The Mummy 4》的事件中扮演重要角色。目前剧情仍未公开，但影片已确定于2027年10月15日上映。

paragraphs.en: Fraser has been tight-lipped about the events of the movie, fearing he might spoil things, but told audiences on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon that he was “doing my best to get this 57-year-old gear in shape."
paragraphs.cn: Fraser一直对电影内容守口如瓶，担心剧透；但他在《The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon》中告诉观众，自己正在「尽最大努力让这副57岁的身体恢复状态」。

paragraphs.en: “I was hopeful for a long while, and then I was like, 'No, I don't know if they are,' you know. Other Mummy movies got made and…" he said of the project. "But anyway, look, what we're going to do is saddle back up, go back to the locations… I should probably stop talking like this because I don't want to give everything away."
paragraphs.cn: 「我有很长一段时间都抱有希望，后来我想，‘不，我不知道他们是不是会拍’，你懂的。其他《The Mummy》电影已经拍出来了……」他谈到该项目时说，「不过，听着，我们要做的是重新上马，回到那些取景地……我最好还是别再这样说了，因为我不想把一切都透露出去。」
